title: Elux Legend Blackberry Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Elux Legend Blackberry Ice Nic Salt delivers the jammy, sweet, and tangy flavour of ripe Blackberries paired with a crisp, cooling Ice finish. The deep berry notes offer a rich, juicy, full-bodied taste of forest fruits, while the subtle streak of icy element brings a clean, frosty sensation that enhances the overall freshness of the vape. Crafted with double-concentrated flavouring, the Elux Legend Nic Salt range is designed to offer a punchier, more intense taste experience that echoes Elux’s most recognisable blends. With its 50VG/50PG ratio and smooth nicotine salt formulation, Blackberry Ice is ideal for use with MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and starter devices. It provides a well-rounded combination of flavour, vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths.
